question:
Directions: Each of the following questions has underlined idioms/phrases. Each sentence is followed by four options. Choose the option that best describes the meaning of the underlined idiom/phrase.

On the fence
solution:
The correct answer is '**Halting between two options**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given idiom '**On the fence**' refers to a situation where an individual is unable to decide or choose between two options. (दो विचारों में उलझा हुआ)

 
 
• **Example**: When it comes to choosing a political side during an election, many people remain **on the fence** until the very end.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct meaning for the idiom '**On the fence**' is '**Halting between two options**'.

Therefore, the correct answer is- “**Option 3**”.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '**On very intimate terms**' refers to being very close or friendly with someone or familiar with something. (बहुत निकटता से)
 
• '**Undaunted by anything**' refers to not being discouraged or intimidated by difficulties or challenges. (किसी भी चीज़ से नहीं डरने वाले)
 
• '**Under all conditions**' means in all situations or circumstances, without exceptions. (सभी परिस्थितियों में)
